an10.89:13.2: “This night, mendicants, toward dawn the glorious divinity Sahampati, lighting up the entire Jeta’s Grove, came to me; having bowed to me, he stood to one side. Standing to one side, mendicants, the divinity Sahampati said to me:
an10.89:13.4: And, sir, the mendicant Kokālika has passed away and has been reborn in the Pink Lotus hell because of his resentment for Sāriputta and Moggallāna.’
an10.89:13.6: Having said this, he bowed to me and respectfully circled me, keeping me on his right, before vanishing right there.”
